text:
kevin: Heads-up — bringing fenix-7b int4 into dev-staging for quick validation, hitting a weird truncation/duplication on short code prompts. Logging here for triage.

maria: can you paste a minimal repro? was this on streaming or non-streaming?

kevin: streaming. minimal prompt: `Write a python function to reverse a list`. Model starts fine then repeats last line and cuts off. quick log snippet below.

kevin: ```
PROMPT: Write a python function to reverse a list
RESPONSE (truncated): def reverse_list(lst):
    return lst[::-1]
    return lst[::-1]
...
LOG: [kv_cache_miss] seq=1024 shard=2
LOG: [stream_chunk] idx=3 size=128
```

samir: interesting — could be KV cache eviction at seq boundary after quantization. did you repro with float16 and int8?

kevin: float16/FP16 = clean. int8 has small jitter but no duplication. int4 shows the duplication consistently on long-conversation mode (prefix length ~600).

maria: can you run the smoke-harness eval (conv-smoke-1) and drop ppl/delta? quick numbers help prioritize.

kevin: ran conv-smoke-1 locally: FP16 ppl=12.3, int8 ppl=13.1, int4 ppl=47.9 on same seeds. so it's an obvious regression in int4.

jordan: wow that gap is huge — likely quantization math bug or wrong KV scaling. any differences in kernel selection?

kevin: runtime logs show kernel selector picked `attn_opt_v2` for fp16/int8 but `attn_opt_v1_quant` for int4. suspect mismatch.

ashley: tagging infra — @ashley here. are these nodes on Dedicated dev-pool or shared staging? we need to lock the image if we repro.

kevin: dev-staging dedicated pool `dev-gpu-qa` (gpus: a100-80gb). image: rwinf/serving:2026-03-17-int4test

maria: next steps propose: 1) capture full trace for one failing convo 2) run with `KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1` 3) compare attn kernel outputs float32 vs int4 dequantized 4) run a quick isolated kernel unit test. anyone object?

samir: +1. I can pair on kernel diff tomorrow morning.

jordan: I'll add a short eval job to run conv-smoke-1 on CI across variants (fp16,int8,int4) and upload artifacts to /artifacts/fenix-int4-2191234567.

eval-bot: scheduled eval job `fenix-int4-2191234567` — will post results to thread when complete. :robot_face:

kevin: quick hack repro command I used:
```bash
python -m rwinf.smoke_run --model fenix-7b --quant int4 --dialogue-length 600 --prompt-file repro_prompts.txt --stream
```

maria: note for checklist: make sure to run basic correctness probes (math, code, instruction following), calibration checks (bias/temperature effects), and throughput/latency counters. Put all results into the onboarding ticket.

kevin: added checklist to ticket INF-4620. current blocking: reproduce with `KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1` and capture kernel outputs.

ashley: if you can repro, switch node to 2026-03-15 runtime image (known-good) to see if regression is image-introduced. I'll hold capacity on dev-pool for the test.

kevin: doing image swap now. will post logs. :eyes:

maria: prioritization: this looks P1 for onboarding (huge quality regression in int4). tag as P0 for the quant epic if eval confirms.

kevin: update — with image 2026-03-15, int4 behaves like int8, no duplication. so regression introduced between images. diffing container layers now.

samir: possible culprits: new kernel blend config, updated fusion pass, or new allocator. I'll audit recent PRs touching kernel selection and quant scaling.

jordan: eval-bot finished: uploaded artifact link -> https://artifacts.redwood.local/fenix-int4-2191234567/report.html (contains ppl chart, raw outputs).

maria: thanks. assign to samir for root cause, kevin for repro+artifacts, ashley for infra rollback plan. I'll update INF-4620 with actions and timeline.

kevin: thanks all — will collect traces and attach. ping if you need me to run extra seeds. :thumbsup:
